title: Multi-agent Architecture Search via Agentic Supernet

layout.note: One gold-outlined rounded frame split by a thick vertical bar: a catalogue of operators on the left, and on the right the supernet with three parallel lanes of query card, sampled grid and workflow that grow taller from top to bottom.

lesson: Show input-adaptive structure by drawing the same node grid once as the full space and once per example with only the sampled nodes solid; let each lane grow with the difficulty of its query and keep the operator key colours on every later drawing of an operator.
